t: 斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基是独立波兰的最后一位国王,被迫退位并被流放到俄罗斯.
te: Stanisław August Poniatowski, the last king of independent Poland, is forced to abdicate and is exiled to Russia.
dz: 波兰分治:斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基是独立波兰的最后一位国王,被迫退位并被流放到俄罗斯.
de: Partitions of Poland: Stanisław August Poniatowski, the last king of independent Poland, is forced to abdicate and is exiled to Russia.

te: The last British troops leave New York City, three months after the signing of the Treaty of Paris.
dz: 美国独立战争：《巴黎条约》签署三个月后，最后一批英国军队离开纽约市。
de: American Revolutionary War: The last British troops leave New York City, three months after the signing of the Treaty of Paris.

dz: 一场地震袭击了地中海,摧毁了贝鲁特和大马士革,造成30 000至40 000人死亡.

de: French and Indian War: British forces capture Fort Duquesne from French control. Later, Fort Pitt will be built nearby and grow into modern Pittsburgh.

dz: 葡萄牙征服果阿:由阿丰索·德·阿尔布开克指挥的葡萄牙海军和为私家提莫吉工作的当地雇佣兵从比贾普尔苏丹国手中夺取了果阿,导致葡萄牙长达451年的殖民统治.
de: Portuguese conquest of Goa: Portuguese naval forces under the command of Afonso de Albuquerque, and local mercenaries working for privateer Timoji, seize Goa from the Bijapur Sultanate, resulting in 451 years of Portuguese colonial rule.

de: Máel Coluim mac Cináeda, King of Scots, dies. His grandson, Donnchad, son of Bethóc and Crínán of Dunkeld, inherits the throne.

dz: 罗马国王塞尔维乌斯·图利乌斯(Servius Tullius)为他战胜伊特鲁里亚人而庆祝他三次胜利中的第一个.
